apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Share and manage application API keys through Entra groups. Other members can take over when people change roles.
apiKeys.loading: Checking group membership and API keys…
apiKeys.noGroups: No security groups matching this environment's eligibility criteria or available products were found for your memberships. Check your Entra memberships and the products permitted by the platform.
apiKeys.usagePlaceholder: For example: Internal help desk · Development
apiKeys.usageHelp: Choose a name that explains the purpose to other group members. Do not enter secrets.
apiKeys.ownerHelp: Owners are Entra security groups matching this environment's eligibility criteria. Current members can view, suspend, delete, and review their keys.
apiKeys.search: Search by purpose, company, or system
apiKeys.noKeysTitle: No keys for this group yet
apiKeys.noKeys: Register application and contact details to create the first key.
apiKeys.noMatches: No API keys match these filters.
apiKeys.detailsDescription: Check usage and manage the API key shared by your group.
apiKeys.created: Key created. Open Manage and select Show keys to view it.
apiKeys.createDescription: Register the owner group and application details to create a key for all released APIs.
apiKeys.createNotice: You can view the keys after creation. Secret values do not appear in this form.

createForm.releasedAccess: This key provides access to all released APIs
createForm.releasedAccessHelp: You do not need to choose a product for each API. APIs requiring your Microsoft identity still require a personal connection.
createForm.noReleasedProduct: This group cannot create keys for released APIs yet. Contact a platform administrator.
createForm.clientTypeHelp: How the calling application is built. Used for usage statistics.
createForm.companiesUnavailable: Could not load companies. Your form values have been kept.
createForm.noCompanies: No companies are available for selection, so a key cannot be created. Ask a platform administrator to check company registration and availability.
createForm.noCompaniesAdmin: No companies are available for selection, so a key cannot be created. Check registration and availability in the company directory.
createForm.manageCompanies: Open company directory in a new tab
createForm.companyOwnershipHelp: The company is recorded for usage statistics. The selected Entra group determines key ownership and management access.
createForm.contactEmailHelp: A mailing list is recommended so the team can be reached when people change roles.
createForm.legacyNotice: Existing verification keys do not have the new usage information registered.

fieldErrors.displayName: Enter a purpose between 1 and 80 characters.
fieldErrors.contactEmail: Enter a valid email address of up to 254 characters.

apiKeys.unlimitedNotice: New keys start with all usage limits unlimited. After creation, set the protection limits you need in the detail view. These are not monetary spending caps.

limits.title: Usage limit settings
limits.description: Set protection limits shared by the primary and secondary keys of this subscription.
limits.requestHelp: Limit this subscription's API calls to a maximum count per specified number of seconds.
limits.tokenHelp: Limit the combined input and output tokens of supported LLM APIs.
limits.quotaHelp: Count combined input and output tokens of supported LLM APIs over the selected period.
limits.resetTime: Periods reset on UTC boundaries. Monthly quotas reset on the first of each month at 09:00 Japan time.
limits.scopeNotice: Token limits do not apply to APIs whose tokens cannot be counted, such as audio, image, or realtime APIs. These controls do not guarantee monetary caps or prevent every overrun.
limits.activationNotice: Settings are saved in the register. After the Gateway integration has been deployed, changes take up to 30 seconds to apply. They are not enforced before that deployment.
limits.saved: Settings saved. Runtime verification through the Gateway is a separate step.

apiKeys.capacityReached: This group has reached its key creation limit.
apiKeys.noProducts: This group has no products available for key creation.
apiKeys.invalidForm: Check the required fields and the values shown in the form.
apiKeys.keyNotice: Keys are hidden after 60 seconds. Check the recipient before sharing a key.
apiKeys.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the displayed value and copy it manually.
apiKeys.suspendNotice: Suspending blocks new calls made with either key for this subscription. You can resume it later.
apiKeys.reviewNotice: Record that you checked the purpose, owner group, and current usage.
apiKeys.deleteNotice: Both keys will stop working. This cannot be undone. Check the impact on applications before proceeding.
apiKeys.processingNotice: APIM is processing this subscription. Refresh the list in a moment.

transfer.title: Change owner group
transfer.description: A current member can transfer ownership directly to another security group matching this environment's eligibility criteria.
transfer.searchHelp: Enter at least the first two characters of the group name. Results match this environment's eligibility criteria and include groups you do not belong to.
transfer.noTargets: No eligible destination groups were found. Try another search.
transfer.noPageTargets: No eligible groups are on this page. Load more groups to continue checking.
transfer.refineSearch: More candidates are available. Load the next page or refine your search.
transfer.otherGroups: Groups you do not belong to
transfer.losesAccess: After this change, you will no longer be able to view or manage this key. You do not belong to the destination group.
transfer.notice: Ownership moves immediately after confirmation, without approval by the destination. The APIM subscription ID, primary and secondary keys, product, and usage limits stay the same. People who copied the keys may still use them; rotate keys separately if necessary.
transfer.confirm: I checked the destination name and Object ID, and understand that key values will not be rotated.
transfer.completed: Owner group changed. The list has been reloaded using your current group memberships.

errors.KeyStoreUnavailable: Couldn't read the API key register. Ask an administrator to check the SQL connection and deployed tables.
errors.AuthorizationUnavailable: Couldn't verify group membership. Wait a moment and refresh.
errors.UpstreamUnavailable: Couldn't reach APIM. Wait a moment and refresh the list.
errors.ProductNotDeployed: The APIM product for issuing keys has not been deployed. Ask a platform administrator to deploy the Gateway, then retry without changing the form values.
errors.UpstreamConflict: APIM has a conflicting or ongoing operation. Refresh the list to check its state.
errors.AuthenticationRequired: Your login has expired. Reload this page and sign in again.
errors.OriginNotAllowed: Couldn't verify this request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.CompanyNotAvailable: The selected company is no longer available. Reload the companies and choose again.
errors.CompanyNotFound: The selected company was not found. Reload the companies.
errors.InvalidRequest: Check the form values and try again.
errors.NotFound: The key was not found, or you no longer have access. Refresh the list.
errors.Forbidden: You cannot manage this group or product. Refresh the list.
errors.LimitReached: This group has reached its key limit for the product.
errors.InvalidLimitSettings: Enter whole numbers within the supported ranges: requests 1–1,000,000, window 1–300 seconds, and tokens 1–2,147,483,647.
errors.LimitVersionConflict: Another member changed these settings. Load the latest settings, then reapply the changes you need.
errors.LimitStoreUnavailable: Couldn't read or save usage limits. Try again in a moment. If the issue continues, ask an administrator to check the register connection and deployment.
errors.OwnershipConflict: Another operation changed the owner group. Refresh the list before trying again.
errors.TargetGroupNotAllowed: This group is not an eligible destination. Search again for a security group matching this environment's eligibility criteria.
errors.TargetSubscriptionLimitReached: The destination group has reached its subscription limit. Choose another group or contact an administrator.
errors.DirectoryResultTooLarge: Too many entries to check at once. Refine the search or ask an administrator to check the owner group register size.
errors.NetworkUnavailable: Couldn't confirm the response. If you were creating a key, check the list before retrying the same operation.
errors.ServiceUnavailable: API key management is unavailable. Wait a moment and try again.

apiKeyAdministration.title: Owner group health
apiKeyAdministration.description: Check whether API key owner groups still exist in Entra and match this environment's security group eligibility criteria. Review subscriptions that can no longer be managed after a group is deleted or becomes ineligible.
apiKeyAdministration.refreshHelp: Manual checks process unverified and oldest observations first, then reload the first page. Check each row's timestamp for coverage.
apiKeyAdministration.syncErrors: Checks failed for {count} groups. These are not treated as deleted. Review their status and timestamps.
apiKeyAdministration.search: Search group name or Object ID
apiKeyAdministration.emptyHelp: Groups appear here after being registered as owners of API keys.
apiKeyAdministration.noLoadedMatches: No loaded groups match these filters. More pages are available to check.
apiKeyAdministration.loadedCount: Loaded {loaded} of {total} groups. Table search and status filters apply to loaded groups. The cards summarize the entire register.
apiKeyAdministration.noAutomaticChanges: This page checks status only. Detecting a deleted or ineligible group does not automatically suspend APIM subscriptions or delete keys.

portal.title: Your AI possibilities, all in one place.
portal.subtitle: Connect models, tools, and agents to bring your team's ideas to life.

modelGateway.description: From text and images to speech. Choose a capability and provider to access AI models through one gateway.

descriptions.text: Generate, summarize, and answer questions. Choose a provider to explore application integration.
descriptions.embeddings: Turn text into vectors for search and similarity comparisons.
descriptions.speech: Transcribe audio files (STT) or turn text into speech (TTS).
descriptions.realtime: Choose from three voice conversation series and realtime transcription.
descriptions.rerank: Reorder search results by relevance to a query.
descriptions.decision: Compare candidates to support decisions and selection.

realtimeSeriesDescriptions.gpt-live: Full-duplex voice conversations that listen and speak at the same time.
realtimeSeriesDescriptions.gpt-realtime: Voice conversations with one model handling audio understanding and replies.
realtimeSeriesDescriptions.voice-live-gpt: Combine Azure speech recognition, GPT conversation processing, and Azure speech synthesis.
realtimeSeriesDescriptions.gpt-live-transcribe: Continuously turn microphone audio into text. No AI audio reply is generated.

modelGateway.notYet: Interactive tests for this capability are coming later. You can explore the available API definitions here.

modelGateway.systemPlaceholder: Example: Give clear and concise answers.
modelGateway.tokenLimitAutomatic: The limit depends on the routed model. Requests use its automatic setting.
modelGateway.tokenLimitUnverified: The output limit is being verified. Requests use the model's automatic setting.
modelGateway.cancelNotice: Stopped waiting for the response. A generation already submitted may still complete on the server.
modelGateway.emptyResult: The model response will appear here.
modelGateway.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the response and copy it manually.
modelGateway.truncated: The output limit was reached. Increase the maximum output tokens if needed.
modelGateway.sendNotice: Your input is sent through APIM to the selected model.

integration.description: Choose a model and parameters to inspect integration examples and request/response formats.
integration.apiMethodHelp: Choose an API supported by this model. OpenAI defaults to Responses when available. The endpoint, JSON, and streaming response format follow your selection.
integration.responsesGuide: Responses accepts the message in input. This example sends a single request with store: false. When streaming, read response.output_text.delta updates and check a terminal event such as response.completed.
integration.chatCompletionsGuide: Chat Completions accepts role and content in messages. This example sends one user message. When streaming, read delta inside choices and continue until data: [DONE].
integration.fixedNotice: Your message and settings are sent to the model. The message is preserved when switching models and is reflected in integration examples.
integration.streamHelp: Receive the response incrementally as SSE (text/event-stream).
integration.keySetup: Set the subscription key in GATEWAY_API_KEY and run on a server or CLI. Never place the key in browser code.
integration.typescriptRuntime: Uses fetch in Node.js 18+. In Next.js, place the code on the server.
integration.pythonRuntime: Uses only the Python 3 standard library.
integration.curlRuntime: Run in a shell such as Bash that expands environment variables.
integration.streamCodeNotice: Examples print incoming SSE events in order. Applications should read the delta in data and update their display.
integration.notConfigured: The gateway URL is not configured. Examples use gateway.example.com.
integration.schemaNotice: JSON Schemas describe the main fields used by this example. Providers may include additional response fields.
integration.sseSchemaNotice: Schema for the data in streaming events. Handle SSE event/data fields and the terminal event.
integration.apiKeyHelp: Choose an active key owned by one of your current groups that permits this API. The key value is used only on the server.
integration.noKeys: No active API keys are available for this API.
integration.requestNotice: Send these settings and your message to the real model through APIM.
integration.emptyResponse: Run the request to inspect its JSON response or SSE events.
integration.parametersChanged: Previous response cleared because the settings changed.
integration.previewNote: Code examples call the public gateway directly. When run here, the portal server adds its subscription key and sends the same request.

descriptions.models: Find the right AI model for your application. Access a range of models through one gateway, with an interface that feels familiar.
descriptions.tools: Connect AI with your everyday workflows. Bring data access and processing tools into your applications through a shared gateway.
descriptions.agents: Put AI agents to work in your applications. Access knowledge, research, and automated workflows through a simple API.

catalog.emptyDescription: Try another keyword or adjust your filters.
catalog.mockNotice: Sample content only. No live API connections are made.

guide.title: Your next idea starts here.
guide.description: Explore the guides and find your way to your first integration.
guide.body1: Explore Model Gateway, Tool Gateway, or Hosted Agent API to find the right service for your application.
guide.body2: Check the endpoint and request format in the details panel. Store real API keys on your application's server.
guide.body3: Make API requests from your application. APIs that access a user's Microsoft account guide them to sign in when needed and use a connection session.
guide.note: Text generation in Model Gateway calls real models. Interactive tests for other capabilities will be added later.

detail.response: Your input was accepted. This is a sample response from the design mockup.
detail.note: This demo runs only in this page. Your input is not sent to an external API.
detail.identityNote: This API requires personal Microsoft authentication. The integration will provide a sign-in URL and manage a connection session.
